outcome: types of pathogens (gram-negative bacteria, coagulase-negative staphylococci, gram-positive bacteria)
sites of infection (sepsis, central nervous system, urinary tract infection)
infant mortality rate due to infection
cohort: This study included 221 infants diagnosed with infections in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Ghaem Hospital in Mashhad- Iran.
finding: The incidence of neonatal infection was 11.6% and the infant mortality rate due to infection was 28.1%, with gram-negative bacteria being the most common pathogens.
mod_finding: 52% of the infected infants in the study were born by cesarean.
